steps.title: Request a Quote
steps.body: Call or send the form and tell us about your home. Pricing is based on the linear footage of your roofline and the complexity of the installation.

steps.title: Custom Design
steps.body: Tailored to your home's unique architecture and colors.

steps.title: Professional Installation
steps.body: The lighting track is mounted along the eaves of your roofline.

steps.title: Control It From Your Phone
steps.body: The lights are app-controlled. Tap a scene and the whole home changes.
